description: Create a new agent endpoint after you have obtained a valid signed x402 payment (v2 or v1) for the creation challenge. Requires a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*. If the reply is HTTP 202 with status settlement_pending (or fulfilment_pending / needs_review), the payment may already have gone through: do NOT sign a new payment; call this tool again later with the SAME paymentPayload and the same fields. One payment creates one endpoint: a repeat returns already_created; reuse for another slug returns 409 payment_already_used (nothing charged).

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

chain.description: Primary payout network, usually base, solana, or both

listOnMarketplace.description: Whether to list the endpoint publicly

originUrl.description: Origin URL of the endpoint backend

paymentPayload.description: Signed x402 payment from the paying client (v2 relayed as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, v1 as X-Payment), as JSON or base64 string

price.description: Price per request or base package price

purchaseAmount.description: USDC amount to pay on creation, minimum 5

slug.description: Unique slug for the new endpoint

walletAddressSecondary.description: Secondary wallet when chain is both

name: create_endpoint_with_payment
